_comment: Synthetic bill-image cases. The golden corpora carry no images and prod

(design §12 — deepseek-v4-flash is text-only, so every bill turn routes to
The PNGs beside this file are rendered by a committed script, not photographed,
so the ground truth is exact: each expectation's `total` is the TỔNG CỘNG
printed on the bill, and `shares` / `tracked` / `balances` come from running
app.money's own split over that total. A vision model that misreads a digit
fails on the number, not on a judgement call.
A bill turn ends in propose_meal, so these also cover the other half of the
Task 0 finding: a vision model that cannot call tools breaks the money path
just as thoroughly as one that cannot see.
